note: Rugged wooded hills and glades southwest of Jonesburg, with Razor Hollow Natural Area, four small fishing lakes and a 6.8-mile hiking, biking and equestrian trail. The area map marks ten primitive camping spots, each beside a parking lot on the gravel road that winds through the area from Tower Road; this one is by the picnic shelter near the middle. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' / 'Individual Campsites'; brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted in spots designated on the area map', 14 days in 30. Free/FCFS/no hookups written manual. The 1/4/2022 map shows 10 Primitive Camping symbols, each beside a P on the MDC improved road (Tower Road's continuation); GIS has the same 10. Pin = GIS 288, ~20 m from lot 1197 under pines by the picnic shelter. All on one through road, so no split. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites, Individual Campsites' and says 'Daniel Boone has multiple primitive camping sites.' Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted in spots designated on the area map.' The map marks ten Primitive Camping symbols, each paired with a Parking Lot on the gravel MDC Improved Road. Not a horse camp: the trail is shared hiking/biking/equestrian and the camping spots are general. No ford, 4WD or length wording on any MDC page.

CLUSTERS (10 spots over ~3 km, one road): GIS 288 = pin (38.7790,-91.3926, picnic-shelter lot by service road 1216); 340 (38.7778,-91.3879, 430 m E, the trailhead lot cluster); 341 (38.7817,-91.3797, 1.15 km NE); 480 (38.7861,-91.3758, 1.65 km NE); 479 (38.7877,-91.3723, 2.0 km NE, by Tower Road's north entry); 339 (38.7716,-91.4004, 1.07 km SW, Lake 3); 287 (38.7718,-91.4052, 1.36 km SW, Lake 4 with picnic shelter); 289 (38.7701,-91.3929, 1.0 km S, Lake 2); 481 (38.7671,-91.3919, 1.3 km S, Lake 1); 338 (38.7646,-91.3924, 1.6 km S near the south entry). All sit on the one MDC improved road through the area (Tower Road enters at the north-east and south ends), so no split.
PIN: stored 38.77903,-91.39255 = GIS camping point 288, ~20 m N of lot point 1197 under pine canopy; the lot itself isn't visible on imagery. Optional move onto the lot point at 38.7789,-91.3924.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the pin spot is in pine/oak woods with no water in view. Lakes 1-4 are small ponds (well under 5 acres on the map).
